kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتكافح (form VI)
# نَتَكَافَحُ (natakāfaḥu) /na.ta.kaː.fa.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
# نَتَكَافَحَ (natakāfaḥa) /na.ta.kaː.fa.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
# نَتَكَافَحْ (natakāfaḥ) /na.ta.kaː.faħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَافَحَ (takāfaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
